rgsCode.description: Standardised RGS (Referentie Grootboekschema) reference code mapped onto this general-ledger account, enabling uniform SBR exchange to KvK, Belastingdienst and CBS (RGS rgs-coa-standard-codes). Hierarchical alphabetic reference code, e.g. 'BLimVap' (immateriele vaste activa).
rgsCode.title: Rgs Code

rgsReferenceNumber.description: Unique numeric RGS reference number that maps one-to-one to the corresponding SBR taxonomy element (RGS rgs-code-structure), e.g. '10101010'.
rgsReferenceNumber.title: Rgs Reference Number
